blocks.text: The streets of Metro Manila have not been treated as shared public space for decades. Instead, they are lawless arenas where the biggest, meanest, or most impatient vehicle wins. Everyday innocent commuters, pedestrians and responsible motorists are paying with their lives for this deep-seated lawlessness. We cried over the many horrible deaths on the roads […]...
